snippet.title: Vespadian Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Vespadian now at https://quinn-patrick.itch.io/vespadian Vespadian is a fantasy role-playing game inspired by Final Fantasy, Dungeons & Dragons, and all sorts of other things. I created Vespadian by myself throughout 2021, basing it off of Chryse, an earlier game of mine.

Play Vespadian when it launches over at https://quinn-patrick.itch.io/ and follow me on Twitter at https://twitter.com/Daisuke9091.

Thank you for playing!
